content: Hey everyone! I'm getting `ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'langgraph'` even though I ran `pip install -r requirements.txt`. I'm on Python 3.12 inside a venv. Any idea what I'm missing? 😕

@marta.dev most of the time that happens because the venv wasn't activated when you ran pip. Try `which python` and `which pip` — if they point to different folders that's your culprit. Run `python -m pip install -r requirements.txt` instead and it'll go into the right interpreter.
